scope: One new changed-price negative case; prerequisite draft setup is not another baseline acceptance. Actual pinned Cloud modules and current CRM native payload/receipt validation; no normal Windows/native runtime.

observation.sentRevisionKind: unchanged order revision, not a current product/quote price witness
observation.requestedBridgeBehavior: Server contract for current price/stock check and the existing reviewed-price policy before linking the same order to one sale; reject stale state (for example 409) or explicitly preserve an authorized quoted price
observation.actual: 400 for the extra order-revision field; bare request creates/finalizes a sale retaining the stored order price after catalog price changed
observation.conclusion: The requested price/quote freshness or reviewed-price decision is not represented by this endpoint. Retaining an order price is not itself proved to be an ERP pricing bug; no automatic repricing is requested.
